spec_refs: SPEC_INVARIANTS §H (survive I1, I2, I5, I6-host, I7)

research round-002 vfg-invariant-survival-table (I1..I8 definitions) and C2 hostile-module corpus list (loops, memory bombs, I/O amplification, forged/stale handles, effective-context switch, double/late responses, non-canonical output, obs-text, crash loops, trap after partial commit)
oracles: reference host (oracle-local Rust workspace, wasmtime =50.0.0) passes both levels

worker-level mutants each red: extra-import (linker exposes a non-F14 import: I1), handle-not-cleared (handle from request n valid in n+1: I1), no-hostcall-quota (I2), no-fuel-no-epoch (I2), no-limiter (memory bomb grows past 16 MiB: I2)

host-level mutants each red: raw-passthrough (module header bytes reach the client unre-serialized: I5), double-response-accepted (I5), audit-after-effect and no-audit-on-trap (I6-host), trap-maps-to-allow (I7), data-run-skips-authorize (I1 capability), tenant-not-overwritten (I1)

acceptance.must: PASS; corpus files map each case to one invariant id; worker level drives aegis-p2 over F14 with the oracle as mock supervisor; host level drives the real aegis binary (feature p2) and judges by response bytes, the F9 audit log and an effect sink (audit-vs-effect diff); README lists every case, its invariant and the expected outcome

notes: Cases at least: I1 non-allowlisted import (instantiate refused, C0), forged/stale/dropped/foreign handle (trap, request failed), effective-context switch attempt (principal/tenant field in data_run ignored and overwritten); I2 loop, memory bomb, table grow, deep recursion, host-call flood, data_run byte amplification, response size bomb; I5 CR/LF/NUL/obs-text/invalid UTF-8 header output, oversized headers, double response, response after trap, partial body then trap; I6-host every data_run has an audit event before its effect, trap after effect still audited; I7 decision export traps/garbage/timeouts => Deny; crash loop => crash budget 429. Default subjects are given by the gates (no default-subject file).
